activation_dependencies: real publisher account configuration is supplied
Google-certified CMP configuration is supplied where required
privacy policy matches the enabled advertising mode
eligible inventory and placement checks pass
rules: Do not add a speculative CMP script or vendor runtime before activation.
Do not block the initial page render on a future CMP or advertising request.
Do not send advertising requests before the required consent state is available.
Do not enable personalized advertising merely because the CMP exists.
Keep /privacy/, /contact/, /ai/, and /tools/ outside the initial advertising inventory boundary.
Use the actual Google-supported CMP/account configuration at activation time; do not guess endpoints, IDs, or CSP sources.
